# RentFriends

> RentFriends is a Polish mobile app and platform for finding flatmates, rooms and flats. It matches people by lifestyle, budget and habits, and helps landlords find suitable tenants. Free to use, currently launching in Wrocław, Poland.

RentFriends works by matching: you create a profile describing your lifestyle, budget, habits and preferences, then swipe through other people's profiles and room listings. Contact is possible only once both sides have shown interest, so nobody receives messages from people they are not interested in.

## Apps

- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.dyzury)
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/gr/app/rentfriends-rent-rooms/id6502833411)

## Optional

- [Add a listing](https://ogloszenia.rentfriends.app/): form for landlords to publish a room or flat listing free of charge.
- Contact: kontakt@rentfriends.app
